messages:
simon_cust: Hey team — since ~12:40 UTC our customers started seeing 429s from the rerank endpoint. Not a huge volume but consistent failures for several tenants. Example response: `{"error":{"message":"Rate limit exceeded","type":"rate_limit","retry_after":30}}`. We only started a small A/B test hitting /v1/rerank with 5 candidates each. Any quick ideas?

priya_support: Sorry you're hitting this, we're looking. Can you paste the exact curl or SDK call you used and the api key (masked) and account id? Also how many calls/sec approx?

simon_cust: Curl below. ~12 req/s from a single job. Account ID 98765, API key `sk-***xyz`.
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-***xyz" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"best restaurants near me","candidates":["A","B","C","D","E"]}'
```

jamal_support: Thanks. Can you confirm whether you're using the hosted route or a dedicated plan? Also whether requests are batched (multiple queries per call) or single per call?

simon_cust: Hosted. Single query per call, but the client spins up ~6 parallel workers, each at ~2 req/s. This started today after we turned on the new candidates-scoring gating in prod.

priya_support: Evelyn from Eng is looping in to help triage. @evelyn_eng can you see any anomalies in rate-limiter metrics for rerank route right now?

evelyn_eng: Looking. I see a sharp bump in rate_limit.errors for route=\/v1\/rerank starting at 12:39 UTC for that account id 98765 and a few others. Total 429s correlate with low to medium qps (2-15qps) which is odd.

ratebot: [automated] quota-change: account=98765 current_rate_limit=60r/m route_variation=rerank

evelyn_eng: Adding quick findings — we shipped a counting-change earlier today to better account for candidate tokens. Bug: the new counter double-counts candidate tokens for batched candidate lists and also accidentally increments per-candidate for the rerank route even for single-query requests. So token accounting for rerank is inflated ~x4 in some code paths. That makes normal traffic hit token-based rate-limits sooner.

jamal_support: Is this definitely the cause? Any repro in staging?

evelyn_eng: Repro'd locally with the sample payload. Before patch: recorded tokens ~120; after patch: ~480. Repro steps: run rerank with 5 candidates -> tokens reported in meter. I have logs and a failing assertion.

priya_support: Immediate mitigation options? Customers need relief now.

evelyn_eng: Short-term: 1) bump the per-account quota for 98765 by 5x (manual override) — low risk. 2) flip feature-flag to revert counting-change for rerank route (if we can push config quickly). Long-term: fix the counting logic and release a hotfix.

ops_bot: [scheduled] created ticket INF-4123 (rerank counting bug) assigned to @evelyn_eng, priority P1.

jamal_support: Priya, can you request quota bump for 98765 and any other accounts with similar symptoms? I'll open an internal support notice and notify affected customers.

priya_support: On it. Bumping 98765 by +300r/m for 2 hours now — manual override id OV-7832. Also found 3 other accounts with identical signature; bumped those too.

simon_cust: Thanks — we saw errors drop immediately after the bump. Still would like the root fix though.

evelyn_eng: Working on patch. Root cause: a helper function that enumerates candidates used both candidate_count * candidate_tokens and then looped again leading to double accumulation. Fix committed in branch fix/rerank-counting (commit 4f7a2b3). Planning hotfix rollout to canary at 13:05 UTC then prod at 13:20 if green.

ops_bot: [deploy-bot] canary deploy started: build=sha-4f7a2b3 env=canary route=rerank

jamal_support: Noted — I'll update customers with ETA for permanent fix.

evelyn_eng: Canary looks good — rate-limit errors down to baseline for canary traffic. Rolling to prod now.

ops_bot: [deploy-bot] prod rollout succeeded: build=sha-4f7a2b3 route=rerank

priya_support: Confirming with simon_cust that they are no longer seeing 429s.

simon_cust: Verified — no 429s for ~8 minutes and throughput looks normal. Appreciate the fast turn.

evelyn_eng: Patch will be backfilled to next stable release and we added unit tests + a metric check that compares pre/post token counts to catch regressions. Also adding an alert to signal when rerank token count growth > 2x baseline for an account.

jamal_support: Closing support escalation after confirming customers are stable. Follow-ups: INF-4123 (fix tracking), OV-7832 (temporary override log), and postmortem to include timeline + lessons.

priya_support: Thanks everyone. Simon, we'll keep you posted in the ticket. :thumbsup:

simon_cust: Thanks team :relieved:

ratebot: [automated] quota-change-revert: OV-7832 expired; quotas returned to normal at 15:00 UTC

jamal_support: Marking this thread resolved. Will attach logs and the commit link in the ticket.
